Full-fit model-query diagnostics

Source: R/csdg_model_diagnostics.R
csdg_model_diagnostics.Rd

These functions calculate complementary diagnostics for a caller-supplied learner that has already been fitted to the complete supplied task. They label the estimand, limitations, interpretation scope, and privacy scope of every returned table.

csdg_effect_diagnostics() returns one-dimensional accumulated local effects (ALE), partial dependence (PDP), individual conditional expectation (ICE) curves, and aggregate ICE summaries. The ALE table is dependence-aware, whereas PDP and ICE are intervention-style model queries that can leave empirical support.

csdg_interaction_diagnostics() screens numeric feature pairs with the Friedman-Popescu H statistic and computes a two-dimensional ALE surface for the strongest nonzero pair or pairs.

csdg_shapley_diagnostics() calculates bounded Monte Carlo Shapley contributions for explicitly supplied cases. Conditional mode uses the package's approximate k-nearest-neighbor sampler and is not exact conditional Shapley estimation.

csdg_prediction_multiplicity() fits caller-confirmed near-equivalent learners to the complete task and summarizes their prediction dispersion. Near-equivalence must be established separately with common held-out splits and a prespecified tolerance.

csdg_mask_effect_support() suppresses sparse one- or two-dimensional ALE estimates while retaining their support counts and an explicit support indicator.

Usage

csdg_effect_diagnostics(
  task,
  fitted_learner,
  features,
  sample_n = 500L,
  ale_bins = 12L,
  grid_n = 15L,
  ice_keep_n = 40L,
  seed = 20260201L,
  class_label = NULL
)

csdg_mask_effect_support(x, min_n)

csdg_interaction_diagnostics(
  task,
  fitted_learner,
  features = NULL,
  sample_n = 400L,
  h_grid_n = 6L,
  ale_bins = 8L,
  top_n_pairs = 1L,
  max_features = 6L,
  seed = 20260202L,
  class_label = NULL
)

csdg_shapley_diagnostics(
  task,
  fitted_learner,
  case_rows,
  background_n = 100L,
  sample_size = 64L,
  seed = 20260203L,
  class_label = NULL,
  mode = c("marginal", "conditional"),
  conditional_k = 5L,
  case_selection = c("post_hoc_communication", "random_analysis_sample",
    "prespecified_external")
)

csdg_prediction_multiplicity(
  task,
  candidate_learners,
  near_equivalent_ids,
  row_ids = task$row_ids,
  seed = 20260204L,
  class_label = NULL,
  range_thresholds = NULL,
  keep_private_predictions = TRUE
)

Arguments

task

An mlr3::TaskSupervised object.

fitted_learner

An mlr3::Learner fitted to every row and feature of task.

features

Unique numeric or integer feature names.

sample_n

Number of task rows sampled for the model queries.

ale_bins

Number of empirical intervals per ALE dimension.

grid_n

Number of points on each PDP and ICE grid.

ice_keep_n

Number of private ICE curves retained per feature.

seed

Non-negative integer random seed.

class_label

Class whose probability is analyzed for classification. It is inferred from the positive class for binary classification and must be NULL for regression.

x

A one- or two-dimensional ALE table returned by these diagnostics.

min_n

Minimum sampled observations required per interval or cell.

h_grid_n

Number of points per feature in the H-statistic screen.

top_n_pairs

Number of strongest nonzero feature pairs for which two-dimensional ALE is computed.

max_features

Maximum number of features admitted to the interaction screen.

case_rows

Between one and 100 task row ids selected for Shapley diagnostics.

background_n

Number of sampled empirical background rows.

sample_size

Number of Monte Carlo draws per Shapley contribution.

mode

Either "marginal" or "conditional".

conditional_k

Number of neighbors used by the approximate conditional sampler.

case_selection

How cases were selected: "post_hoc_communication", "random_analysis_sample", or "prespecified_external".

candidate_learners

A uniquely named list containing at least two mlr3::Learner objects.

near_equivalent_ids

At least two names from candidate_learners that a separate held-out comparison has classified as near-equivalent.

row_ids

Non-empty subset of task row ids on which to compare predictions.

range_thresholds

Optional finite, non-negative thresholds for the cross-model prediction range.

keep_private_predictions

Whether to return row-level predictions and dispersion.

Value

csdg_effect_diagnostics() returns ale_1d, pdp, ice_private, ice_quantiles, ice_spread, and settings.

csdg_interaction_diagnostics() returns interaction_screen, ale_2d, and settings.

csdg_shapley_diagnostics() returns local_private, global, additivity_private, and settings.

csdg_prediction_multiplicity() returns private row-level outputs when requested, aggregate distribution, model_summary, pairwise, threshold_shares, and settings.

csdg_mask_effect_support() returns a copy of x with unsupported effect estimates replaced by NA, plus support_threshold and supported columns.
